risks.title: Economic Fluctuations and Capital Spending
risks.score_rationale: The company's financial results closely follow changes in general economic conditions and capital spending levels in the industries it serves. Demand for most products depends on new capital investment and maintenance expenditures by customers.

risks.title: Foreign Currency Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: A significant portion of revenues (54% for year ended December 31, 2025) is denominated in currencies other than the U.S. dollar, and much of manufacturing and labor costs are also outside the U.S., creating exposure to exchange rate movements.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in highly competitive markets where it faces competition on product quality, reliability, pricing, and service responsiveness.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on technology for its operations, making systems vulnerable to security breaches and operational disruptions.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the countries where it operates, which can impact operations and financial results.

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on suppliers for raw materials and components such as steel, aluminum, copper, and castings, making operations vulnerable to supply chain disruptions.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation for product quality, reliability, and service is essential to maintaining long-standing customer relationships and market positions. Incidents could significantly impact financial results.
